name: Ce Zhang

affiliations.role: Neubauer Associate Professor of Computer Science

bio: Ce Zhang is co-founder and CTO of Together AI and a Neubauer Associate Professor of Computer Science at the University of Chicago, having moved there in 2024. Earlier, Zhang was a professor at ETH Zurich, and received a PhD at the University of Wisconsin-Madison followed by a postdoc at Stanford. Zhang works on data-centric machine learning systems and decentralized AI training.
known_for: Machine learning systems and data management
